summary: Iteration 30 verified Round 69 — Paid-Practice partner ISOLATION + Connect UI swap + gold Chat pill. BACKEND (11/11 pytest PASSED, iteration30.xml): (1) GET /api/users/partners?paid_practice=true returns the standalone pool (3 demo users: Emma Wilson, Amélie Laurent, Yuki Tanaka) and every user in it has paid_practice=true. (2) Default GET /api/users/partners (no params) excludes all 3 paid users. (3) Same exclusion holds for ?language=all, ?language=en/es/ja/fr/zh, ?location=<paid user's country>, ?gender=male, ?gender=female, ?online_only=true, ?search=<paid user's first name>, and ?min_age/max_age. Not a single paid_practice=true user leaks into any non-paid endpoint. Implementation in /app/backend/routes/users.py:377 sets query['paid_practice']={'$ne':True} on every non-paid branch — correct. FRONTEND (Playwright, mei@demo.com, mobile 390x844): (a) On Connect 'All' tab the connect-filter-match Best-Match chip is present and paid-practice-banner is absent. (b) Tapping connect-cat-practice hides ALL connect-filter-* chips (count went from ≥1 to 0) and reveals paid-practice-banner. (c) 3 partner cards render with partner-rate-{id} rate badges (50/day, 80/day, 30/day) and gold partner-message-btn-{id} 'Chat' pill (iter30_practice_tab.jpg). (d) Tapping paid-practice-banner navigates to paid-practice-overview and all three sections render: 'What is Paid Practice?', 'Where do I find Paid Practice?', 'Paid Practice Rules' (iter30_overview.jpg). (e) ppo-back returns to Connect. (f) Switching back to connect-cat-all restores the chips and hides the banner. No demo data was mutated (only reads).
verified_flows: GET /api/users/partners?paid_practice=true → returns 3 demo paid partners; every card has paid_practice=true
?search=<first name of a paid user> → excludes paid users
Connect All tab shows connect-filter-* chips and NO paid-practice-banner
Connect Paid Practice tab hides connect-filter-* chips and shows paid-practice-banner
Paid-practice cards render partner-rate-{id} rate badges and gold partner-message-btn-{id} 'Chat' pill
Tapping banner navigates to paid-practice-overview with all 3 sections
ppo-back returns to Connect; switching back to All restores chips
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/users.py:360-374 — paid_practice branch returns the standalone pool BEFORE the non-paid guard is applied. Good.
backend/routes/users.py:377 — query['paid_practice']={'$ne':True} on every other branch guarantees paid users are filtered out at the Mongo level, so no filter combination can leak them.

frontend/app/(tabs)/connect.tsx:283-336 — category==='practice' cleanly swaps the filter-chip row for the paid-practice-banner Pressable. Filter state is preserved but not shown, so returning to All keeps the previously selected filter.
frontend/app/(tabs)/connect.tsx:59-60 — when category==='practice' the API call sets paid_practice=true and OMITS language/location/gender params. Correct.
frontend/src/components/PartnerCard.tsx:241-249 — gold paidBtn with 'Chat' label + cash icon is rendered ONLY when item.paid_practice=true. Non-paid partners keep the round waveBtn.
frontend/src/components/PartnerCard.tsx:167-175 — rateBadge (partner-rate-{id}) also rendered only when paid_practice=true, showing item.practice_rate ?? 50 /day.
paid-practice-overview.tsx — testIDs paid-practice-overview + ppo-back present; all three required section titles rendered; router.back() used for the back button (works from banner-tap navigation).

success_rate.frontend: 100% observed (banner swap, gold Chat pill, rate badge, overview sections, back navigation all verified live)
